docs.description: Explicit map of tag to module URL: {"x-chart": "/js/x-chart.js"}. Wins over pattern.
URL template for tags not in modules, with {tag}, e.g. "/components/{tag}/{tag}.js".
Regular expression the tag must match before pattern applies, e.g. "^x-". Empty: every unknown custom element.
Tags a component renders itself, loaded with it: {"x-table": ["x-cell"]}.
Base for relative URLs. Default: the document's base URL.
Class removed from <html> once the components present at startup have loaded or failed, or after timeout (against the flash of undefined elements).
Remove the cloak class after this many ms, whatever happens (sb-ready still waits for the loads).

slots.name: default
slots.description: Optional markup to wrap; it renders exactly as written.

events.name: sb-load
events.description: After a component is defined. detail: { tag, url }.

events.name: sb-load-error
events.description: When a module fails to load, or loads without defining its tag. detail: { tag, url, error }.

events.name: sb-ready
events.description: Once, when every component present at startup has loaded or failed (right away when there were none). detail: { loaded }.
